description: Use this when someone asks how many stairs or steps they need, how to build or size a staircase, a stair's rise and run, stringer length or stairwell opening, or whether a stair meets code. Calculates a stair that climbs a floor-to-floor height in equal steps: the number of risers, riser height, tread depth, total run, pitch, stringer length, stairwell opening and floor space, straight or with an L or U landing, checked against a stair rule. Rules: irc2021 (United States), ukPartK (England), din18065 (Germany), cte (Spain), dm236 (Italy), nbr9050 (Brazil), blondel (the comfort rule used in France).

first.description: Risers before the landing of an L or U stair.

floor.description: Thickness of the upper floor, for the size of the opening, in millimeters.

rise.description: Height from finished floor to finished floor, in millimeters; at least 300.

riser.description: Riser height to aim for, in millimeters.

rules.description: The stair rule of the country where the stair is built.

shape.description: Straight, or an L or U stair with a landing; straight when left out.

tread.description: A fixed tread depth, in millimeters.

width.description: Clear width of the stair, in millimeters.

name: calculate_stairs
title: Stair calculator
